privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title must be exactly 'SaaS Pricing Strategy 2026'. Question 1 (PREF) must be 'List (Radio)' and contain an HTML table with values: Starter ($29/mo, 1 User), Pro ($79/mo, 5 Users), and Enterprise (Custom, Unlimited). Question 2 (INTEG) must be 'Multiple choice'. Crucially, the answer 'No integrations needed' in INTEG must have the 'Exclusive option' property set to 'Yes' or checked in the subquestion settings.
